The reference's _selection_range_cache (reference/src/textual/widgets/tabs.py:143-146) is read after the cursor has advanced, so each range is shifted right by len+rpad. For ' A  B ' with padding 1 the reference yields (2,5) and (5,8), while the tabs occupy cells (0,3) and (3,6). The candidate matches the intended click targets.

Divergence B, candidate-favorable: set_focus. App.set_focus is async (app.py:306). The reference calls self.app.set_focus(None) without await (reference/src/textual/widgets/tabs.py:248), so Escape never runs. The candidate awaits it (tabs.py:326).

Divergence C, candidate-favorable: zero-width labels. Base layout_resolve treats size 0 as flexible (_layout_resolve.py:38). The candidate omits the label edge for empty labels (tabs.py:167-169). The reference adds Edge(size=0, fraction=None) (reference tabs.py:99), and reading the base solver, a flexible edge with fraction None reaches 'portion * edge.fraction' and would raise TypeError unless remaining space is <= 0.

Divergence D, candidate-favorable: duplicate names. The candidate indexes the underline through the full tab list and maps each index to its displayed name (tabs.py:194-220). The reference uses the full-list bar offset to index its de-duplicated label cache, so the bar drifts when names repeat.
Divergence E, matches the docstring: the candidate searches first characters only for single-character keys (tabs.py:333). The reference passes any key string to the search.
